div.div:
A dynamic label marks tags that must follow every new version. wizard create version copies such a tag into the new version, and the copy carries a marker with the value need_gen_uuid.
The original has no marker. An XSLT can tell the fresh copies from the old tags and give them a new value. The next-uuid step of the UUID protocol example does exactly that.
